THE DIRECTIONS
You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.
The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE
You are alone at the desk on the school game show. This is the last game, and you cannot leave the desk. The game uses one page from an old travel book. You need four parts of that page. Four people each have one part.
THE HISTORY
That travel book is the Green Book. Victor Green made it in Harlem in 1936. It listed hotels and places to eat for Black families. He put a heading for each state. People could find their state fast.
